answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5591 Country: United States of America Title: Is there any cure for getting rid of having an acne type disease on one's back? Question: Assalamu Alaykum, Is there any cure for getting rid of having an acne type disease on one's back? Answer ID: 5591 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 184/184=M) Allah has created medicine for every disease. Yet, these medicines depend on Allah?s order to cure a person. The servants have been asked to look for ways of treatment. There are medicines for the abovementioned diseases as well. For treatment, you should consult a physician or a hakim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
